sentences.en: The following passage is a quotation from a well-known fable.
sentences.zh: 下面这段文字是一则众所周知的寓言的引文。

sentences.en: The speaker was so well-known as to need no introduction.
sentences.zh: 这位演讲者非常出名，以至于无需介绍。

sentences.en: Mr Gilmore is so well-known as to need no introduction.
sentences.zh: 吉尔莫先生如此鼎鼎大名，以至于无需介绍。

senses.zh: 出名的，众所周知的，熟悉的,鼎鼎大名,闻
